content.short: Harpie is the first on-chain firewall that protects users from hacks, scams, and theft.
content.description: Harpie continuously monitors your wallet, checking for potentially harmful activity hundreds of times per second. When we detect a malicious transaction or transfer, Harpie can intervene and stop it while it is still in transit. This proactive protection helps reduce the risk of hacks and scams, so you can interact with Web3 with greater confidence. By adding a security layer to your transactions, Harpie aims to prevent unauthorized moves and keep your assets safer during decentralized activity.
